findings.function: getConfig(), updateConfig 0x21b60e7f, and the storage-to-memory copies of Subscription.consumers / Config arrays (getSubscription, cancelSubscription, removeConsumer, ownerCancelSubscription, sendRequest paths)
findings.source: FunctionsRouter.sol getConfig() returns s_config (Config with uint32[] maxCallbackGasLimits); updateConfig: s_config = config; Subscription memory copies of consumers
findings.issue: Copies of packed uint32[] arrays between storage (8 per slot) and memory, and the clearing of the old tail, print as rotated loops driven by byte offsets ('s - Mask(251, 5, s + 7) / 8 - s * ((s + 7) / 32) + 4'), with bounds expressed as memory addresses ('32 * stor11.length + 480 > idx + 32'); the address[] consumer copies print the same way. Nothing says that these are copies of stor11 / consumers.
findings.rule: A loop whose induction variables are a memory word pointer (step 32) and a (slot, byte offset) pair advancing by k bytes with carry into the slot is the element-wise copy of a packed array of k-byte elements; print it as one copy line (e.g. 'mem[480 len 32 * n] = stor11[0 len n]' with element width k), and the clearing loop as 'stor[p len m] = 0'. P7 with packed elements.

findings.source: FunctionsRouter.sol:466 for (uint8 i = 0; i < s_proposedContractSet.ids.length; ++i) if (id == ids[i]) return to[i]; revert RouteNotFound(id) (and the s_route lookup)
findings.issue: The search loop is rotated, its condition is the difference 'id - ids[i]' instead of 'id != ids[i]', the array element is raw slot arithmetic 'stor[sha3(12) + i]' although the length is stor12.length, and the slot hash is recomputed (with its scratch write) in every iteration.
findings.rule: As in c00496: a difference tested for nonzero is '!='; 'stor[sha3(n) + i]' is storn[i]; a keccak of constant scratch contents is a constant, computed once.
